item.title: China Unicom Rolls Out Shore-Sea-Ship-Satellite Net With 1,500 Maritime Stations
item.description: China Unicom launched Guangdong's Shore-Sea-Ship-Satellite ocean network with nearly 1,500 coastal base stations. The build shows why sea-surface cellular still matters beside LEO satellite internet under the six-networks infrastructure push.

item.title: Huawei Ships Kirin 9050 Pro With LogicFolding Architecture Under Tao's Law
item.description: Huawei's Kirin 9050 Pro commercializes LogicFolding under Tao's Law, raising transistor density about 55% and cutting power in key workloads. The story is chip stacking, interconnect and thermal design; the Mate XT 2 is only the first carrier.

item.title: Alibaba Opens Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B Weights as First Qwen-Max-Class MoE
item.description: Alibaba's Qwen team published open weights for Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B, a 2.4-trillion-parameter MoE with 95 billion active parameters. Hybrid attention and long context target agentic workloads, with same-period SageMaker HyperPod and vLLM recipes.

item.title: Ant Group Opens Ling-3.0-flash-VL Multimodal Model With Vision Feedback Loop
item.description: Ant Group and inclusionAI open-sourced Ling-3.0-flash-VL, a 124B MoE multimodal model with 5.5B active parameters. BF16 and FP8 weights arrived September 9 with a vision feedback loop for agentic GUI, front-end and medical tasks.

item.title: AgiBot Unveils GE-Act 2.0 Native World-Action Model With 100x Data Scaling
item.description: AgiBot released GE-Act 2.0, a native world-action model pretrained from random initialization on embodied data. Scaling from 300 to 30,000 hours unlocked zero-shot skills such as towel folding across two robot embodiments.
